label: minimal-code-composite

arms.A: committed prompt files, no candidate copied in
arms.B: candidate: hoisted and compressed minimal-code rule in agents/executor.md, compressed Minimal-Code Principle plus deleted Code Changes restatement in agents/sisyphus.md, rewritten Coding discipline in output-styles/omca-default.md, smallest-diff line in the SCOPE section and smallest-diff clause in the post-delegation diff review in skills/start-work/SKILL.md

decision_reason: No correctness regression on either fixture, but mean lines_added on diff-latitude rose from 18.33 in arm A to 25.33 in arm B. The criterion required a lower mean on the candidate arm, so the composite reverts.
harness_note: plugin_root was recorded empty for every trial: the skillsPath grep in the runner did not match this client's debug-log format, and the worktrees were removed before the gap was noticed. Every trial used --plugin-dir pointed at its own worktree, so the arm assignment is unaffected, but the field could not be filled in after the fact.
variance_note: Arm A spread was 3 to 28 added lines across three trials, wider than the 39 to 58 spread recorded in the baseline batch at an earlier commit. Three trials per arm cannot separate a small real effect from that spread; the verdict here is that the candidate did not shrink diffs, not that it made them larger.
